entities.name: 2005 Iranian Air Force C-130 crash
entities.label: Place
entities.summary: On 6 December 2005 at 14:10 local time, a Lockheed C-130 Hercules military transport aircraft of the Islamic Republic of Iran Air Force, tail number 5-8519, c/n 4399, crashed into a ten-story apartment building in a residential area of Tehran, the capital city of Iran.
